topics.theme: How an ignition interlock device works
topics.hint: Demystify the device in friendly terms: you blow into it, the car starts if you're clear, occasional rolling re-tests. Reassure that it's routine and people adjust quickly.
Explain one piece of the Colorado interlock/reinstatement process clearly. Point legal/eligibility questions to the DMV or an attorney. No legal advice.
Colorado requires calibration every 60 days. Encourage booking ahead so they never miss a window. Friendly nudge, not scary.

topics.theme: Path to getting your license back
topics.hint: Frame the interlock period as a forward step toward full reinstatement. Encouraging and concrete. Direct legal questions to DMV/attorney.
Pick one real FAQ (cost, install time, what to bring, lockouts, cold weather, sharing the car) and answer it plainly.
Highlight that we serve a specific Northern Colorado town (rotate: Greeley, Fort Collins, Loveland, Windsor, Johnstown, Longmont, Timnath, Ault, Evans). Local and welcoming.
Lean on real trust signals: 5.0 stars, 47+ reviews, BBB A+, authorized Lifesafer & Guardian, bilingual. Warm, not boastful.
Reassure that we often have same-day or next-day openings, so they can get back on the road quickly.
Let Spanish-speaking neighbors know we serve them comfortably. Consider including a short Spanish line.

topics.theme: What to expect at your first appointment
topics.hint: Walk through the install visit calmly: how long (2-4 hrs), what to bring, what happens. Reduce first-visit anxiety.
Tie to the Colorado season (winter cold starts, summer travel, etc.) with a genuinely useful interlock tip. Keep it helpful, never fear-based.
